name: Blistered Cherry Tomato, Pesto & Ricotta Tartines with Mixed Greens

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ small pkgs fresh basil
3 medium carrots
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.

Transfer tomatoes to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and broil until soft and lightly charred, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems and transfer to a blender.
Peel garlic. Add to blender along with oil, salt, and pepper. Blend on high, adding water 1 tbsp at a time, if necessary, to form a semi-smooth pesto.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
½ cup extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Toast bread using a toaster. Alternatively, transfer bread to a baking sheet pan; place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until nicely toasted, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine oil, vinegar, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and grate the carrots; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To assemble the tartines, divide ricotta between slices of toast and spread out in an even layer. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (425 g) pkgs ricotta cheese
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Layer tartines with tomatoes, pesto, and pine nuts.
To serve, divide salad and tartines between plates. Enjoy!
